mission.title: Redpill's Bane
mission.description: Escort a Zion recruitment team, and see that their recruit never reaches Zion.

npc.say: That's a good plan: you get Hayden Allen while we stand guard out here.
Well, okay, we can hold them off while you get the recruit. Just hurry.

phase.briefing: A new human group of masked ruffians has begun harassing Zion's recruitment teams. We have decided to allow this group to disrupt some of Zion's recruitment operations. Under the terms of the Truce, you are detailed to escort one of the recruitment teams--but if the masked humans attack, you are not to interfere.

enter.say: The Zion recruitment operatives Butterfly and Gaffey are inside that building. Get them outside.

talk.say: Be prepared for trouble--we've had a lot of teams hit by those masked thugs lately.

objective.text: Lead Butterfly and Gaffey out of the building

phase.briefing: Now you will take the two humans to meet their potential recruit. The waypoint will show you the recruit's location.

enter.say: The Zion recruit Hayden Allen is in that building. The masked humans have already entered the area, and it looks like they're terrorizing the bluepills inside. Lead Butterfly and Gaffey to Mr. Allen's vicinity and await further orders.
Bring Butterfly and Gaffey to that room.
Listen carefully. Leave the Zion operatives there and go through the far door. In the next two rooms you will find one or more masked humans, and the Zion recruit. Destroy them all.
Delete any masked humans that you find in that room. Make the fight noisy. We want the recruiting agents to overhear it.

talk.say: Here is the human recruit, Mr. Allen. Eliminate him.

done.say: Good. It is in our interests to keep the growth of Zion within tolerable... limits. Of course, you will blame his deletion on the masked humans.
Now lead the recruiters Butterfly and Gaffey out of the building. Watch out for more masked humans--you may slay them if they annoy you.

objective.text: Kill all of the masked humans

done.say: Well done. The Zion recruiters will have heard you fighting off thugs--who were about to eliminate the recruit, of course. At least, that is what you will tell them.

objective.text: Lead Butterfly and Gaffey out of the building

phase.briefing: Good. Now lead the two recruitment operatives to the extraction point nearby. Check the waypoint for the location.

enter.say: The Zion extraction point is inside that building.

objective.text: Lead Butterfly and Gaffey to Sijthoff

done.say: Where are Allen and our two recruitment operatives?
Leave the area now, operative. Those humans appear to be a bit... touchy.

complete.say: Oh great. How can Zion maintain itself if we can't get any new people from the Matrix? Those masked men have become a serious problem.
Those stupid thugs and their twisted dream-world! They're killing their only real hope for survival!
Things are getting bad. We can't go on losing recruits like this.
Damn! I wish I had been there to help.
This is a sad day. Hayden Allen will be remembered in Zion.

mission.finish: That was an excellent piece of work, {player}. Zion is poorer by one recruit and not only do they blame the masked humans for it, but the masked humans don't even suspect that you aided them in their own objective. It is almost a pity that our foes are so easily manipulated.
